correctness.rationale: The coprime normalization is birational and has one affine parameter line; derivative-critical pairs give precisely \(N=(a-1)(b-1)/2\) transverse real nodes and Euler topology gives \(N+2\) chambers. Alternating derivative signs on every regular fibre of the degree-\(a\) projection bound the winding to \(a+1\) levels; the attributed published winding-basis theorem identifies the generated algebra with \(\mathbb Q[w]\). The deficiency follows by exact inequality, and three explicit test points with quadratic-radical roots prove the lone positive case \((2,3)\). The finite verification script corroborates, but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification for all coprime Chebyshev plane diagrams of whether the new winding filtration generates the chamber-function algebra in degree one. It resolves the 2026 source’s explicitly motivated generation question on a substantial infinite family, identifies the unique generating case, supplies an all-parameter projection-degree obstruction and an explicit ungenerated dimension growing with degree; it is not a finite sample or a mere recomputation of known node counts.
